integrity: The quantified result is proved analytically; finite numerical checks are sanity checks only.
The earliest public-source date is the first arXiv submission date of arXiv:math/0409200.
The p=3 special case is acknowledged as prior coverage and is not presented as new by itself.
limitations: The theorem is for real conjugate Day–James planes with p>2; it does not cover nonconjugate pairs, complex scalars, or higher dimensions.
For general p the balance point is characterized uniquely but implicitly.
An unindexed historical equivalent formulation in older distance-ellipsoid literature remains a residual originality risk.

title: Exact Euclidean Banach–Mazur distance of conjugate Day–James planes
